quotes.text: Congress must make sure there are protections in place, especially for minors, as technology rapidly evolves. The TAKE IT DOWN Act will make sure that when individuals are victimized and inappropriately distorted through AI, they have strong mechanisms to take action and remedy such traumatic situations,

Where does artificial intelligence fall into the overall platform or plans for the federal judiciary? [...] And so, the Task Force consists of gifted people across the country identifying the AI issues that we deal with now, and hopefully, anticipating them in the future.
